import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    idx = 0
    n = data[idx]
    idx += 1
    arr = data[idx:idx+n]
    idx += n
    arr.sort()
    itv = data[idx]
    idx += 1
    ans = 0
    def get(pos):
        count = 0
        max_val = arr[pos] + itv
        for i in range(pos, n):
            if arr[i] <= max_val:
                count += 1
        return count
    for i in range(n):
        res = get(i)
        if res > ans:
            ans = res
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
